en.summary: Validate and publish matching project and Module tags
details: swban deploy/release/tag --check  #Validate HEAD and show the tag plan without publishing
swban deploy/release/tag          #Atomically publish both version tags to origin
Tags use SemVer: vX.Y.Z and module/vX.Y.Z point to the same commit and match its Theme and Skill versions.

zh.summary: 校验并发布配套的项目与 Module 标签
details: swban deploy/release/tag --check  #校验 HEAD 并输出标签计划，不发布
swban deploy/release/tag          #向 origin 原子发布两个版本标签
标签采用语义版本：vX.Y.Z 与 module/vX.Y.Z 指向同一提交，并与该提交的 Theme、Skill 版本一致。
